title: Mosaic
description: An interactive computational-geometry studio: Voronoi by both half-plane intersection and Fortune's sweep-line, power (Laguerre) diagrams with their regular-triangulation dual, the farthest-point Voronoi diagram, Delaunay and constrained Delaunay (Lawson edge-flips), convex hulls by both monotone chain and Quickhull, the β-skeleton family (Gabriel↔RNG) and k-nearest graph alongside the full proximity-graph nesting, alpha shapes with an animated α sweep, Ruppert quality meshing, rotating-calipers metrics, Welzl's enclosing circle, largest empty circle, Lloyd and power-Lloyd relaxation, and a Spatial Search explorer — k-d trees and quadtrees driving live nearest-neighbour, k-nearest, orthogonal-range and point-location queries — the latter by the Θ(√n) jump-and-walk and two independent O(log n) locators — Seidel's trapezoidal map with an animated search-DAG descent and Kirkpatrick's vertex-removal hierarchy (all cross-verified against brute force and each other) — plus (1+ε)-approximate best-bin-first NN and a fractional-cascading 2-D range tree for O(log n + k) range reporting. A Curves studio animates the Morton (Z-order) and Hilbert space-filling curves and measures their locality; the Studio adds Yao/Θ/greedy/WSPD geometric spanners — the WSPD-spanner drawn from a well-separated pair decomposition over a fair-split tree — each with a measured dilation. NEWEST — a Polygons axis for AREAL geometry: boolean set operations (union ∪, intersection ∩, difference −, XOR) on general polygons-with-holes via a from-scratch planar-arrangement sweep (verified live by the inclusion–exclusion identity |A∪B|+|A∩B|=|A|+|B|), Minkowski sums (convex angle-merge + non-convex triangulate-and-union), and translational MOTION PLANNING — grow obstacles by the robot's reflection into configuration-space obstacles, build the visibility graph, and Dijkstra the shortest collision-free path — plus a Bentley–Ottmann sweep-line intersection visualizer in the Algorithms gallery. An Arrangements axis for the DUAL world of geometry: the arrangement of n lines with its faces coloured by level and Euler's V−E+F=2 checked live, the zone theorem of a draggable line, point–line duality (collinear points ↦ concurrent lines), k-levels and lower/upper envelopes, the HAM-SANDWICH cut that simultaneously bisects two point sets via their median levels in the dual, and 2-D LINEAR PROGRAMMING by Seidel's randomized incremental method (cross-checked against a brute-force vertex scan). NEWEST — a Space axis, the first that leaves the plane: a from-scratch software 3-D renderer (no WebGL — solids projected, depth-sorted and flat-shaded by hand) drives the 3-D CONVEX HULL by the incremental horizon algorithm (with live Euler V−E+F=2, volume and sphericity), the paraboloid LIFTING MAP that reveals 2-D Delaunay as the lower convex hull one dimension up (raise the points onto z=x²+y² and watch Delaunay emerge — verified to contain every Bowyer–Watson triangle), and 3-D DELAUNAY by Bowyer–Watson in space with its dual, the 3-D VORONOI foam. NEWEST — a Visibility axis: the O(n log n) monotone-decomposition polygon TRIANGULATION (a plane sweep types every vertex — start / end / split / merge / regular — and cuts the polygon into y-monotone pieces along diagonals dropped to stored helpers, then triangulates each piece by the linear stack walk), the ART GALLERY theorem made constructive (Fisk's proof: 3-colour the triangulation → ⌊n/3⌋ guards that provably cover the gallery), the star-shaped VISIBILITY POLYGON of a draggable viewpoint by angular sweep, and Euclidean-shortest GEODESIC paths inside a polygon via the Lee–Preparata FUNNEL walking the triangle-dual portals — with an animated monotone-sweep stepper added to the Algorithms gallery. Every algorithm is built from scratch, with a 265-check test suite (Monte-Carlo boolean membership oracles, area identities, Minkowski forward-membership, sweep ≡ brute force, motion-plan collision-freedom, Euler's formula, ham-sandwich bisection, Seidel-vs-brute-force LP, exact polygon-triangulation area tiling, the ⌊n/3⌋ art-gallery guard bound + full coverage, visibility polygons agreeing with a brute-force see-test, geodesics obeying the straight-line lower bound, plus 3-D orient/insphere signs, hull convexity + Euler + volume, the lifting-map empty-circumcircle + hull-coverage identity, and the 3-D Delaunay empty-circumsphere property all included).
